description: PromptAndPray enforcement gates: Gate 1 (non-writer subagents cannot write), Gate 2 (the Writer dispatch gate - a click on every dispatch, or only on one the active PLANs cannot account for, per enforcement.dispatchGate, and which denies a Claude-hosted plan-readiness pass whose readiness artifacts are missing) and Gate 4 (an ask-class git verb is denied to a non-writer subagent, whose dialog nobody would see, and raises one for the main session in the git forms the shipped ask rules never spell out - git.exe outside push/merge/rebase, a wrapper the harness does not strip; the same file is the habit guard, which denies every actor a pipe into tail, head or Select-Object -First/-Last, a cd prefix (Push-Location and popd too, read through a leading call operator or block opener), a global git -c and any git -C <path> form, each with a hint). Gate 4 is wired on BOTH shell tools, matcher "Bash|PowerShell" - a matcher of only letters, digits, _, -, space, comma and | is an exact alternation list, not a regex - because a permission rule is addressed to a tool and a Windows session carries a PowerShell tool next to Bash.
